title: ClientConfig
description: Response of GET /api/config on the transfer port: the minimum a client needs in order to talk to this server. The admin port answers the same path with the operator's full view (config.schema.json); this one is deliberately short, since everything else is either already in the blueprint, stated per response by the headers, or operational data a client has no business seeing.

hashAlgorithm.description: Algorithm behind the archive hashes and the per block hashes in the framing.

maxBlockSize.description: The server's --max-block-size: the hard upper bound for any block on the wire. A client must reject a frame claiming a larger length; that is the one thing it uses this document for.
